moments.tail:
# Answer
Write only a JSON array, nothing else. Best moment first, at most {n}, no overlaps:
[{"start": seconds, "end": seconds, "punch": second the punchline starts, "score": 0-10 how funny, "title": "short title", "why": "why it is funny, one sentence"}]

passages.head:
The speaker's voice goes over a music edit (sad edit / viral edit). Pick the best {n} of these passages.
Good: understandable alone, needs no context, strong feeling or claim, ends on a line that sticks.
Bad: half an idea, mentions the screen/link/subscribing/sponsor, a list of technical steps.
passages.tail: Write only a JSON array, best first, at most {n} numbers: [3, 0, 7]

videos.head: Pick the {n} of these videos that make the best material for a music edit (sad edit / viral edit). Good: strong, memorable, emotional talk and interesting pictures. Skip boring, technical, list-reading videos.
videos.tail: Write only a JSON array, best first, {n} numbers: [2, 0]

lines.head: Pick the best {n} sentences to show as text over a sad / viral edit: meaningful alone, strong feeling, memorable. Skip technical ones and ones that need context.
lines.tail: Write only a JSON array, the {n} numbers in the order to show them: [4, 1, 9]
